nodes.label: MediScanQR (Project)
nodes.rationale: Digitizes prescriptions to reduce fraud, eliminate duplicate dispensing, and improve healthcare workflow efficiency versus paper prescriptions, which are easily lost, forged, hard to verify, and lack centralized tracking.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.rationale: Provides secure, stateless authentication and protects API routes so only authenticated users can access role-specific features.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
nodes.rationale: Restricts each user type (Doctor, Patient, Pharmacy, Admin) to role-appropriate actions, ensuring only authorized users can create, view, verify, or dispense prescriptions.

nodes.label: Secure QR-Code Prescription Verification
nodes.rationale: QR codes let pharmacies verify prescription authenticity at the point of dispensing without paper, reducing forgery and fraud risk.

nodes.label: Duplicate Dispensing Prevention
nodes.rationale: Prevents pharmacies from dispensing the same prescription more than once, directly addressing a key weakness of paper prescriptions.

nodes.label: Audit Logging
nodes.rationale: Maintains a centralized trail of prescription actions for administrators to monitor and review, addressing the lack of centralized tracking in paper-based systems.

nodes.label: System Architecture (Doctor -> Backend -> DB -> Patient/Pharmacy -> Admin)
nodes.rationale: Doctor creates a prescription persisted via the Express backend into MongoDB; Patient views the QR code while Pharmacy verifies and dispenses it, updating prescription status; Admin oversees the whole flow.
nodes.norm_label: system architecture (doctor -> backend -> db -> patient/pharmacy -> admin)
